title: grounded_loop
description: A work item's contract for deterministic, measured completion. Two separate gates: legality_gate (is the work well-posed?) and metric_target (did a named, oracle-measured signal actually move?). A loop only earns a hard 'completed' when its metric_target moved as declared; otherwise it is flagged. Soft outcomes must state their limits — an unverifiable claim is never a hard green.

legality_gate.description: Is the work legal/well-posed BEFORE we judge its effect? Separate from whether it moved a metric.

metric_target.description: The named signal this loop must move, and the oracle that measures it.

name.description: Plain-language name of what should change (human-readable).

oracle.description: Loop-type key into grounded_oracle_map (e.g. test-loop, contract-loop, lint-loop, health-loop).

baseline_cmd.description: Optional command that reads the current metric value.

soft.description: True when the outcome cannot be deterministically measured; it is then labeled, never counted as a hard green.

soft_limits.description: Required when soft==true: what the soft label does and does not assert.
